# Sunblind Games

> Sunblind Games is an independent video game studio based in Madrid, Spain, and the developer of FKC: Fighting Krazy Chickens!

## Main pages

- [FKC: Fighting Krazy Chickens!](https://sunblindgames.com/FKC/): Official game page with gameplay, premise, characters, modes, Steam link, and contact information.
- [The Studio](https://sunblindgames.com/TheStudio/): Official information about Sunblind Games, its current project, social profiles, and press contact.

## FKC facts

- Full name: FKC: Fighting Krazy Chickens!
- Short name: FKC
- Developer and publisher: Sunblind Games
- Genre: comedic physics-based action and bullet-heaven game
- Core mechanic: grab enemy chickens and throw them back into battle as ammunition
- Modes presented on the official site: Adventure, co-op, and King of the Ring
- Official Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4916140/FKC_Fighting_Krazy_Chickens/

## Official contact

- Email: contact@sunblindgames.com
- Location: Madrid, Spain
